name: Pho Minh pagoda
kicker: Stone tower on the Trần ground
summary: Give the morning to the stone tower on the same Tức Mặc ground as Đền Trần. The heritage page prints 19.51 m and a base of 5.20 m. The 2018 city page prints 21.2 m and a base edge of 5.21 m. Both stay. A gate hour and a ticket were not printed. Check on arrival.
getThere: The same Tức Mặc ground as Đền Trần. Minutes from the cathedral were not printed.
heroCaption: The stone tower at the end of the palm walk

notice.title: No gate hour was printed
notice.body: A ticket and a daily gate hour were not on the heritage page or the 2018 city page. Check on arrival. The 08:00–09:00 palanquin move on 27 February 2026 was one year’s rite, not a daily hour.

body: Walk the pagoda and the stone tower. The heritage page gives the tower a square base of 5.20 m and a full height of 19.51 m, ending in 14 storeys at the lotus finial. The 2018 city page gives 14 storeys, 21.2 m, a base edge of 5.21 m, and about 700 tons on about 30 m². Both heights stay. Both base edges stay. The hall is a chữ Công plan. The front hall is 9 bays, 24.93 m by 8.22 m. Steles on the heritage page are dated Cảnh Trị 6 (1668) and Duy Tân 1 (1907). The city page says the latest major repair was 1994–1995.

The ministry treats this pagoda and Đền Trần as one special national relic. The heritage page puts the ground at thôn Tức Mặc, phường Lộc Vượng, thành phố Nam Định, tỉnh Nam Định. The 2026 plan says phường Nam Định, tỉnh Ninh Bình. Both wordings stay. On that page, Thiên Trường sits in the middle, Cố Trạch to the east is Trần Hưng Đạo, and Trùng Hoa to the west is the 14 kings. The tourism administration instead says Thiên Trường is the 14 kings and Trùng Hoa is the kings plus mandarins. Both assignments stay. Do not pick one.

The seal night is the reason many people come, on the 14th of lunar month 1. The tourism page times the start at 22:00. The 2026 plan clears the yard from 21:00 and runs the seal palanquin until 23:10. Both clocks stay. The next solar date is check on arrival. A gate hour on an ordinary day was not printed.

gettingThere: The pagoda is the same Tức Mặc ground as Đền Trần. A minute from the cathedral in the center was not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the center
legs.body: The cathedral, Chợ Rồng, and the Hàng streets are a walk in the center. Đền Trần and Phổ Minh are the Tức Mặc ground. A minute between them was not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hanoi
legs.body: Ga Nam Định is kilometre 87. Southbound SE cells differ by 1 hour 40 minutes or 1 hour 41 minutes. SE7 is Hà Nội 06:00 and Nam Định 07:40. The fare is not on the table. Check on arrival. The minute from the station to the tower was not printed.

closed: No weekly closing day was printed.
admissionNote: No ticket was printed on the heritage page, the tourism page, or the 2026 ward plan. Check on arrival. No child rule was printed.
